---
title: "MB1A Practical 1 - HPA"
author: "Harmony"
---

In this document I will compare the total number of genes with regionally elevated expression in the forebrain (cerebral cortex, basal ganglia, thalamus and hypothalamus) in humans, pigs and mice.

Humans:
```{r}
total_elevated_genes_human <- sum(180, 83, 57, 110)
print(total_elevated_genes_human)
```

Pigs:
```{r}
total_elevated_genes_pig <- sum(109, 157, 31, 45)
print(total_elevated_genes_pig)
```

Mice:
```{r}
total_elevated_genes_mouse <- sum(55, 185, 60, 98)
print(total_elevated_genes_mouse)
```

The species with the highest total number of genes with regionally elevated expression in the forebrain was 430 in Humans.
